reason: The Industry combobox does carry autocomplete="garbage", which is not a valid token. But Industry is a five-item picklist (Startup, Ecommerce, Crypto, Consulting, Investing) and is not one of the 53 input purposes that 1.3.5 lists, so no AA criterion fails. The name and role still reach the accessibility tree as combobox "Industry".
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve one of the 53 purposes in the Input Purposes list (name, email, street-address, and so on). Industry is a custom picklist with five options and maps to none of them, so the invalid autocomplete token fails nothing. 4.1.2 passes: the ax probe shows role combobox, name Industry, expanded and haspopup exposed. 4.1.1 Parsing no longer exists in WCAG 2.2. Every other form field in the dialog uses the valid token off.
